title: Wharness Local Project Divergence v1
description: How the local project moved since the complete snapshot the planner already holds. Carried on every continuation as context-delta/delta.json so a correction round rebases its pending edit instead of re-reading the project. Always measured against the ROOT request's anchored base, never the previous round's, so a report that was lost or unread does not break the chain.

base_request_id.description: The Main Request whose snapshot the planner holds. This report describes divergence from that snapshot.

source.description: git is a real content comparison between two anchored request bases. manifest is the degraded path-only comparison used when Git cannot answer. unavailable means Wharnex could not prove what changed, and must be reported as such rather than as an empty change list.

unchanged.description: True means not one project file diverged. This is load-bearing, not an absence of news: it tells the planner a patch that failed to apply did not fail because the tree moved.

truncated.description: More paths diverged than Wharnex enumerates. The list is then a sample and the attached manifest stays authoritative.

patch_omitted_reason.description: Why no diff accompanies the report. An unexplained absence would invite the planner to assume the listed changes were cosmetic.
